text:
Both Results-desk specs, R1-3 (referee of strict MC120 and Corollary P) and R1-4 (referee of the A6 paired producer), are relayed to referee lane chat-2345d7f398 as one combined message. Together they were about 8.2k characters, over the 5000-character limit, so I condensed them. Every definition, question, deliverable and acceptance rule is kept; only wording was shortened. Swarm smwh32yr0 is still running (2 of 8 members accepted), so start_successor=false. The coordinator will route R1-3 and R1-4 to members as they free up, or to the next successor, with no second swarm.

My own pre-read is not a verdict, but nothing in either spec looks wrong:
- MC120: the common positive arc has length 180−L. The chord condition 2·r0·sin λ = 1 gives λ < 30° < B/2. A finite subcover takes care of the pointwise delta. The empty-residual case and the translated-pair step are sound.
- Corollary P: two non-adjacent edges with the same direction would exclude 4 labels in one direction, contradicting CC60. So each direction class is an adjacent pair, which is a perfect matching (01)(23)(45) or (12)(34)(50).
- A6: I recomputed all 12 table cells and the forcing g=(4,2,0,4,2,0) from the cosines. The phase matches P (j=0 gives {1,4}).

The referees still have to deliver independently. No Lean is queued this cycle. The queue is idle, and the only supplied .lean is the already-passed CyclicCoreConsumerFromV2, which the plan says not to requeue. I staged six lane artifacts for review.
